mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, o.total_amount, o.status, o.address, o.receiver, o.phone, o.remark, o.pay_time, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, o.total_amount, o.status, o.address, o.receiver, o.phone, o.remark, o.pay_time, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, o.total_amount, o.status, o.address, o.receiver, o.phone, o.remark, o.pay_time, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, o.total_amount, o.status, o.address, o.receiver, o.phone, o.remark, o.pay_time, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address, receiver, phone, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{address}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal})

INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productImage}, #{item.price}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.subtotal})
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = #{status}, pay_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE pay_time END, ship_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 2 THEN NOW() ELSE ship_time END, finish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 3 THEN NOW() ELSE finish_time END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM `order` GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 1 AND status != 4 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as paid, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as pending FROM `order`

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as amount FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 1 AND status != 4 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as amount FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
